build.description: Lint Markdown, then generate all ports

md-fix.description: Fix Markdown issues with rumdl (wraps long lines)

icons-fetch.description: Download SVG replacements for ayu's PNG-only icons into src/icons (keeps existing files)

icons-compare.description: Open a page comparing the upstream ayu (Sublime) icons with the Zed icons

tasks.firefox-export: cd firefox && rm -rf .export ayu-vivid-space.zip && mkdir -p .export/ayu-vivid-space/chrome .export/ayu-vivid-space/img && cp install.sh CREDITS.md .export/ayu-vivid-space/ && cp chrome/userChrome.css chrome/userContent.css .export/ayu-vivid-space/chrome/ && cp img/background.gif .export/ayu-vivid-space/img/ && cd .export && zip -qr ../ayu-vivid-space.zip ayu-vivid-space && cd .. && rm -rf .export
tasks.firefox-pack: cd firefox && rm -f ayu-vivid-space.xpi && zip -qr ayu-vivid-space.xpi manifest.json img CREDITS.md
